description.html: Maple leaf stone is a decorative stone with a distinctive layered structure that resembles maple leaves - hence the name. The natural lines and layers in the stone create an impressive visual effect, especially when several pieces are arranged together in a layout. It is extremely popular in aquascaping, where it is used to create dramatic rock formations that imitate mountain cliffs or riverbanks.

It is chemically inert and does not affect water parameters, which makes it safe for all types of freshwater aquariums. Every 1kg piece is unique in shape, color and layer pattern. It can also be used in terrariums as a decorative element that adds a natural look. Combined with low plants and moss, maple leaf stone becomes the centerpiece of a striking aquascape.
